text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky achieved a splendid result
on the grand stage of the Arima Kinen.
Yet her expression remained somewhat rigid.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it was fun.
It was fun, buttt...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That was a bit beyond what I expected, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I already knew she was strong, and I knew she got waaaay stronger after overcoming her injury, but still...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Man,
feels like Grass-chan has entered her second phase, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, of course.
Sei-chan showed everyone what she's made of too, after all~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, it wasn't that I took it lightly or got arrogant.
I gave it everything I had. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky suddenly fell silent.
Looking closely, her shoulders wereâtrembling slightly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Looks like I won't make it in the Senior Class unless I start using my head a lot more.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Shall we have a nice, fun strategy meeting?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as Seiun Sky shook off her anxiety and prepared to move forward—
someone was watching her back.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...So this path
ends here, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I've finally made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You walk your path.
And I will—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Down my path.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, um, about the next race...
I'd like to tell you my thoughts... *fidget*"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What do you think about
the Tenno Sho (Spring)?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring). A prestigious, traditional race characterized by its 3,200-meter distance—the longest among GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It seems like I can put on quite a good performance at longer distances.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll win the Tenno Sho (Spring)
and become the Seiun Stayer☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Spe-chan will definitely enter too.
Well, that's just my gut feeling, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps Seiun Sky wants to reaffirm his own strength by facing his greatest rival."
choice_data_list: Understood, let's run the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do our best~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Maaan, I'm exhausted today~
Sei-chan is completely limp. Out of juice~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, why don't we hold our strategy meeting over a meal?
Come on, splurge a little on me!☆"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Never hurts to ask, huh!
Well, don't mind if I do~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Su, su, su~♪ The 'Su' in Sky stands for...
Sushi! Sukiyaki! Sugatani (braised whole fish)~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we continued to train even harder
in preparation for the Tenno Sho (Spring).
